title: Dart Professional Readiness Assessment
attempt_policy: Draft recommendation: allow two attempts followed by targeted remediation; confirm platform policy before publication.

distribution.area: Functions, collections, null safety, modern types, OOP, generics
Build, interoperability, publishing, specialist workflows, migration

outcomes: Write and reason about type-safe Dart programs.
Select suitable asynchronous/data abstractions and handle failures.
Test, review, package, and document a maintainable Dart project.
Recognize platform/API constraints and apply security and release checks.
remediation: Route incorrect topic areas back to associated lessons and exercises; this blueprint is content only and does not issue certificates or persist an exam result until a backend exam workflow is configured.
